title: Battleaxe leg lighting and landscaping
text: A battleaxe leg, including any adjoining setbacks, is provided with adequate lighting and be landscaped and provided with adequate lighting to pathways and vehicle access areas.

replaces.note: Part C C3.7.10-C3.7.12; new deemed exempt for R40 and below (Part B relied on subdivision policy)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: 'Adequate' lighting and 'landscaped' need a planner; no evaluator.
